overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies wholesale Beetroot Powder for food and ingredient manufacturing. The product is made from selected beetroot, processed into a fine milled powder, and offered for bulk supply with consistent handling. It is suitable for buyers who need a dependable ingredient for beverage, bakery, seasoning, and dry mix applications, with standard and custom specifications available on request.

The powder is produced through a controlled process that includes sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing with dispatch. Buyers can request 80 mesh, alternative particle sizes, custom packaging, and private-label support. TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India, with export documentation support and sample options available.
industries: Instant food and dry mix production

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for Beetroot Powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg.

faqs.q: Can you supply 80 mesh Beetroot Powder?
faqs.a: Yes. 80 mesh is available, and custom mesh sizes can also be discussed on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM or private-label packing?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM and private-label packing are available, including small pouches and jars where suitable.
Standard packaging includes 25 kg bags and HDPE containers, with 5-10 kg bags and private-label retail packs available on request.

faqs.q: Can I request a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Samples can be arranged on request for evaluation.

faqs.q: What support do you provide for exports?
faqs.a: TradeNest Naturals provides export documentation support and can align packaging and specifications based on the destination requirement.
